name: Ziha
overview: The name Ziha appears in Scripture as associated with the Nethinim, a group dedicated to temple service. Specifically, the children of Ziha are listed among the Nethinim in Ezra 2:43 and Nehemiah 7:46, indicating a familial or clan identity within this group. Additionally, Nehemiah 11:21 reveals that Ziha held a leadership role, overseeing the Nethinim who dwelt in Ophel, highlighting his position as a ruler among these temple servants.
